name: manual_04f59c
claim: Fable-5 Tool Cataloging: Auto-discover 100% of skills/MCP/agents (70+/100+) with zero manual registration. Generate docs/generated/tool-catalog.json unioning SKILL.md frontmatter + MCP roots + worker_registry live regs. Runtime availability reuses connectivity.py endpoint_online() cache (single source of truth). Registry-stale tools flagged by CI before commit (LINT-302). Catalog-first fail-closed tool selection. Consensus: 5/7 subagent types. Foundation: ECC 2.0 fragmentation-detection precedent (docs/v2/ D21).

decisions.notes: Current state: 70+ tools scattered across skills/, MCP servers, and worker_registry; hand-maintained catalog fragments cause stale-tool selection, unnecessary retries, and cascaded fallbacks. Connectivity.py endpoint_online() model-id-served verification proven; reusing its cache eliminates duplicate probes. sync_tool_registry.py --check already enforces freshness in CI. Operationalizes automatic discovery per orama docs/v2/ (zero-fragmentation pattern).
